# uptimeeye_locations (Data Source)

The pinger locations (regions) available to run monitor checks from. Use this to reference valid `locations` values for `uptimeeye_monitor`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "uptimeeye_locations" "all" {}

output "locations" {
  value = data.uptimeeye_locations.all.locations
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `locations` (List of String) Identifiers of the available pinger locations.
